thread:
nina_newhire: hey all, day 1 snag. i can ssh to bastion but can't connect to the internal postgres at 10.30.2.10:5432 from my laptop. `psql` just times out. anyone seen this with home networks? :thinking:

wg-bot: WireGuard: peer=nina_newhire, latest_handshake=12s ago, endpoint=198.51.100.22:51820

omar-sre: welcome! first guess: carrier NAT or split-tunnel route missing so traffic to 10.30.0.0/16 isn't going over wg0. can you paste `ip route` and `wg show`?

nina_newhire: ip route shows default via 192.168.1.1 and wg0 present but no 10.30.0.0/16 route. `wg show` allowedips includes 10.30.0.0/16 though.

ria-eng: if allowedips are set but route not installed, try restart of wireguard service or `sudo ip route add 10.30.0.0/16 dev wg0`. short-term you can tunnel psql over bastion: `ssh -L 15432:10.30.2.10:5432 nina@bastion.redwood.internal -N` then `psql -h localhost -p 15432 ...`.

nina_newhire: did the ssh -L trick and it worked, thanks!! pulled the DB schema. saved me.

omar-sre: we'll update the new-hires network checklist with the ssh -L and ssh -D recipes and a note about restarting wg if routes missing. also filing a ticket to harden onboarding automation so wg routes are applied reliably.

paul-security: quick policy note: do not expand egress allowlists for consumer carrier IPs. the bastion-tunnel workaround is fine for onboarding. please include reason in the ticket (onboarding + CGNAT).

ticket-bot: created NET-789: "onboarding: ensure wg route install + add ssh tunnel recipes" (created by omar-sre).
